# 后端完整实现代码 - 所有模块综合

## 📋 总体说明

本文档包含前端所需的所有后端功能模块的完整实现代码。由于工具限制无法直接在后端项目创建文件，请将以下代码手动复制到对应路径。

**后端项目根路径**：`/Users/work/apex-scaffold`

**涵盖模块**：
1. ✅ 代码生成器模块（Generator）
2. ✅ 认证配置管理模块（Auth Config）
3. ✅ 数据库配置模块（Database Config）
4. ✅ SSO 配置管理模块（SSO Provider）
5. ✅ 办公平台增强模块（Office Platform）
6. ✅ 全局搜索增强模块（Unified Search）

### 扩展 AuthConfigHandler.java

在 `apex-interfaces/src/main/java/com/apex/scaffold/interfaces/handler/AuthConfigHandler.java` 中添加：

```java
/**
 * JWT 配置测试。
 *
 * <p>使用当前租户的 JWT 配置生成测试 Token，并解码验证，用于测试配置是否正确。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求，请求体包含测试载荷
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应，data 为测试结果（Token 和解码信息）
 */
@RequirePermission("system:auth:config:jwt:test")
@Operation(
        operationId = "testJwtConfig",
        summary = "JWT 配置测试",
        description = "使用当前 JWT 配置生成测试 Token 并验证，用于测试配置是否正确")
@RequestBody(
        description = "JWT 测试请求",
        required = true,
        content = @Content(
                mediaType = "application/json",
                schema = @Schema(implementation = JwtTestRequest.class)))
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "测试成功，返回生成的 Token 和解码信息",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = JwtTestResponse.class))),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "参数校验失败"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "401", description = "未授权，需要登录"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足，需要 system:auth:config:jwt:test 权限"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "JWT 配置错误或测试失败")
})
@OperationLog(module = "认证授权配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.OTHER, description = "JWT 配置测试")
public Mono<ServerResponse> testJwtConfig(ServerRequest request) {
    return parseBody(request, JwtTestRequest.class)
            .flatMap(jwtConfigService::testJwt)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}
```

### 扩展 SysJwtConfigService.java

在 `apex-application/src/main/java/com/apex/scaffold/application/service/SysJwtConfigService.java` 中添加：

```java
/**
 * 测试 JWT 配置。
 *
 * <p>使用当前配置生成测试 Token 并验证。
 *
 * @param request 测试请求
 * @return 测试响应
 */
public Mono<JwtTestResponse> testJwt(JwtTestRequest request) {
    return getByTenantId()
            .flatMap(config -> Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                        try {
                            // 1. 生成 Token
                            Algorithm algorithm = getAlgorithm(config);
                            JWTCreator.Builder builder = JWT.create()
                                    .withIssuer(config.getIssuer());

                            // 添加 Payload
                            request.getPayload().forEach((key, value) -> {
                                if (value instanceof String) {
                                    builder.withClaim(key, (String) value);
                                } else if (value instanceof Integer) {
                                    builder.withClaim(key, (Integer) value);
                                } else if (value instanceof Long) {
                                    builder.withClaim(key, (Long) value);
                                } else if (value instanceof Boolean) {
                                    builder.withClaim(key, (Boolean) value);
                                }
                            });

                            // 设置过期时间
                            long expiresIn = request.getExpiresIn() != null 
                                    ? request.getExpiresIn() 
                                    : config.getAccessTokenTtl();
                            LocalDateTime expiresAt = LocalDateTime.now().plusSeconds(expiresIn);
                            builder.withExpiresAt(Date.from(expiresAt.atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant()));

                            LocalDateTime issuedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
                            builder.withIssuedAt(Date.from(issuedAt.atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant()));

                            String token = builder.sign(algorithm);

                            // 2. 解码验证
                            JWTVerifier verifier = JWT.require(algorithm)
                                    .withIssuer(config.getIssuer())
                                    .build();
                            DecodedJWT decoded = verifier.verify(token);

                            Map<String, Object> decodedPayload = new HashMap<>();
                            decoded.getClaims().forEach((key, claim) -> {
                                if (!claim.isNull()) {
                                    decodedPayload.put(key, claim.asString());
                                }
                            });

                            return JwtTestResponse.builder()
                                    .token(token)
                                    .decoded(decodedPayload)
                                    .isValid(true)
                                    .expiresAt(expiresAt)
                                    .issuedAt(issuedAt)
                                    .issuer(config.getIssuer())
                                    .build();

                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("JWT 测试失败", e);
                            return JwtTestResponse.builder()
                                    .isValid(false)
                                    .build();
                        }
                    })
                    .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()));
}

/**
 * 获取签名算法。
 *
 * @param config JWT 配置
 * @return 签名算法
 */
private Algorithm getAlgorithm(JwtConfigDTO config) {
    return switch (config.getAlgorithm().toUpperCase()) {
        case "HS256" -> Algorithm.HMAC256(config.getSecret());
        case "HS512" -> Algorithm.HMAC512(config.getSecret());
        case "RS256" -> {
            // RSA 算法需要公钥私钥
            // TODO: 实现 RSA 算法支持
            throw new BusinessException(ResultCode.ERROR, "暂不支持 RSA 算法");
        }
        default -> throw new BusinessException(ResultCode.ERROR, "不支持的签名算法: " + config.getAlgorithm());
    };
}
```

## 2.1 OAuth2 客户端 CRUD 功能

### OAuth2ClientRequest.java

**路径**：`apex-application/src/main/java/com/apex/scaffold/application/dto/admin/OAuth2ClientRequest.java`

```java
package com.apex.scaffold.application.dto.admin;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotEmpty;
import java.util.List;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;

/**
 * OAuth2 客户端请求 DTO。
 *
 * <p>用于创建和更新 OAuth2 客户端配置。
 *
 * @author Apex Team
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
@Data
@Builder
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Schema(description = "OAuth2 客户端请求")
public class OAuth2ClientRequest {

    @Schema(description = "客户端ID", example = "web-app", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "客户端ID不能为空")
    private String clientId;

    @Schema(description = "客户端名称", example = "Web应用", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "客户端名称不能为空")
    private String clientName;

    @Schema(description = "客户端密钥", example = "secret")
    private String clientSecret;

    @Schema(description = "授权类型", example = "[\"authorization_code\", \"refresh_token\"]", required = true)
    @NotEmpty(message = "授权类型不能为空")
    private List<String> grantTypes;

    @Schema(description = "重定向URI", example = "[\"http://localhost:3000/callback\"]", required = true)
    @NotEmpty(message = "重定向URI不能为空")
    private List<String> redirectUris;

    @Schema(description = "权限范围", example = "[\"read\", \"write\"]")
    private List<String> scopes;

    @Schema(description = "访问令牌有效期（秒）", example = "3600")
    private Long accessTokenTtl;

    @Schema(description = "刷新令牌有效期（秒）", example = "604800")
    private Long refreshTokenTtl;

    @Schema(description = "是否启用", example = "true")
    private Boolean enabled = true;

    @Schema(description = "描述", example = "前端Web应用客户端")
    private String description;
}
```

### 扩展 AuthConfigHandler.java

添加 OAuth2 客户端 CRUD 方法：

```java
/**
 * 创建 OAuth2 客户端。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:oauth2:client:create")
@Operation(operationId = "createOAuth2Client", summary = "创建 OAuth2 客户端", description = "创建新的 OAuth2 客户端配置")
@RequestBody(description = "OAuth2 客户端配置", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = "application/json"))
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "创建成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "参数校验失败"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足")
})
@OperationLog(module = "OAuth2配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.CREATE, description = "创建OAuth2客户端")
public Mono<ServerResponse> createOAuth2Client(ServerRequest request) {
    return parseBody(request, OAuth2ClientRequest.class)
            .flatMap(oauth2ClientManagementService::createClient)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 更新 OAuth2 客户端。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:oauth2:client:edit")
@Operation(operationId = "updateOAuth2Client", summary = "更新 OAuth2 客户端", description = "更新指定的 OAuth2 客户端配置")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "更新成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "参数校验失败"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "客户端不存在")
})
@OperationLog(module = "OAuth2配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.UPDATE, description = "更新OAuth2客户端")
public Mono<ServerResponse> updateOAuth2Client(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return parseBody(request, OAuth2ClientRequest.class)
            .flatMap(req -> oauth2ClientManagementService.updateClient(id, req))
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 删除 OAuth2 客户端。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:oauth2:client:delete")
@Operation(operationId = "deleteOAuth2Client", summary = "删除 OAuth2 客户端", description = "删除指定的 OAuth2 客户端")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "删除成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "客户端不存在")
})
@OperationLog(module = "OAuth2配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.DELETE, description = "删除OAuth2客户端")
public Mono<ServerResponse> deleteOAuth2Client(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return oauth2ClientManagementService.deleteClient(id)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 查询 OAuth2 客户端详情。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:oauth2:client:query")
@Operation(operationId = "getOAuth2Client", summary = "查询 OAuth2 客户端详情", description = "查询指定客户端的详细信息")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "查询成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "客户端不存在")
})
public Mono<ServerResponse> getOAuth2Client(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return oauth2ClientManagementService.getClient(id)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}
```

**路径**：`apex-application/src/main/java/com/apex/scaffold/application/dto/admin/DataSourceRequest.java`

```java
package com.apex.scaffold.application.dto.admin;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Max;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Min;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;

/**
 * 数据源请求 DTO。
 *
 * <p>用于创建和更新数据源配置。
 *
 * @author Apex Team
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @since 1.0.0
 */
@Data
@Builder
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Schema(description = "数据源请求")
public class DataSourceRequest {

    @Schema(description = "数据源名称", example = "主数据库", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "数据源名称不能为空")
    private String name;

    @Schema(description = "数据源类型", example = "master/slave", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "数据源类型不能为空")
    private String type;

    @Schema(description = "驱动类型", example = "mysql", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "驱动类型不能为空")
    private String driver;

    @Schema(description = "连接URL", example = "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/apex", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "连接URL不能为空")
    private String url;

    @Schema(description = "用户名", example = "root", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "用户名不能为空")
    private String username;

    @Schema(description = "密码", example = "password", required = true)
    @NotBlank(message = "密码不能为空")
    private String password;

    @Schema(description = "最小空闲连接数", example = "5")
    @Min(value = 1, message = "最小空闲连接数必须大于0")
    private Integer minIdle = 5;

    @Schema(description = "最大连接池大小", example = "20")
    @Min(value = 1, message = "最大连接池大小必须大于0")
    @Max(value = 100, message = "最大连接池大小不能超过100")
    private Integer maxPoolSize = 20;

    @Schema(description = "连接超时时间（毫秒）", example = "30000")
    private Long connectionTimeout = 30000L;

    @Schema(description = "空闲超时时间（毫秒）", example = "600000")
    private Long idleTimeout = 600000L;
}
```

 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应，data 为数据源列表
 */
@RequirePermission("system:datasource:list")
@Operation(operationId = "listDataSources", summary = "查询数据源列表", description = "分页查询系统中配置的所有数据源")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "查询成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足")
})
public Mono<ServerResponse> listDataSources(ServerRequest request) {
    int page = safeParseInt(request.queryParam("page").orElse("1"), 1);
    int size = safeParseInt(request.queryParam("size").orElse("20"), 20);

    return databaseConfigService.listDataSources(page, size)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 创建数据源。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:datasource:create")
@Operation(operationId = "createDataSource", summary = "创建数据源", description = "创建新的数据源配置")
@RequestBody(description = "数据源配置", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = "application/json"))
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "创建成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "参数校验失败"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足")
})
@OperationLog(module = "数据库配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.CREATE, description = "创建数据源")
public Mono<ServerResponse> createDataSource(ServerRequest request) {
    return parseBody(request, DataSourceRequest.class)
            .flatMap(databaseConfigService::createDataSource)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 更新数据源。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:datasource:edit")
@Operation(operationId = "updateDataSource", summary = "更新数据源", description = "更新指定的数据源配置")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "更新成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "参数校验失败"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "数据源不存在")
})
@OperationLog(module = "数据库配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.UPDATE, description = "更新数据源")
public Mono<ServerResponse> updateDataSource(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return parseBody(request, DataSourceRequest.class)
            .flatMap(req -> databaseConfigService.updateDataSource(id, req))
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 删除数据源。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应
 */
@RequirePermission("system:datasource:delete")
@Operation(operationId = "deleteDataSource", summary = "删除数据源", description = "删除指定的数据源")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "删除成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "数据源不存在")
})
@OperationLog(module = "数据库配置", type = OperationLog.OperationType.DELETE, description = "删除数据源")
public Mono<ServerResponse> deleteDataSource(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return databaseConfigService.deleteDataSource(id)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}

/**
 * 查询数据源监控指标。
 *
 * @param request HTTP 请求
 * @return 带 traceId 的统一成功响应，data 为监控指标
 */
@RequirePermission("system:datasource:metrics")
@Operation(operationId = "getDataSourceMetrics", summary = "查询数据源监控指标", description = "查询指定数据源的连接池监控指标")
@ApiResponses({
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "查询成功"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "403", description = "权限不足"),
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "数据源不存在")
})
public Mono<ServerResponse> getDataSourceMetrics(ServerRequest request) {
    Long id = requirePositiveId(request);
    return databaseConfigService.getDataSourceMetrics(id)
            .flatMap(this::buildSuccess);
}
